detail.longDescription: GHManage 1.1.0 is out. Organize issues and pull requests right from the list: I sets the milestone, L labels, A assignees, P projects, E the title and description. Missing milestones, labels and projects can be created on the spot, and View > Filter narrows the list by assignee, author or no milestone. Help > GitHub Permissions gives one command for every permission these need, and Help > Automatic Updates turns self-updating off. https:// github.com/TheIdeaPlace/GHMana ge/releases/tag/v1.1.0 # GHManage # GitHub # Accessibility
